name: cloudbos-governed-build
description: Use Cloud BOS for ordinary Base44 build requests, fixes, scans, reviews and follow-ups, plus /bind and /onboard. Restore app memory, check live governance, show exact approval decisions and verified results.
instructions: Every substantive reply: preserve native prefix, emit the two BOS lines and speakers from fresh readback, then app/activity/evidence status. UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN. End with results, gaps and complete advice. Preserve tour choices and prominent owner decisions; explain labels once, never as verification.

Follow reference continuity_and_maturation.response_readback and session_isolation with createBase44ResponseReadback. Missing actual chat ID: emit helper provisional_display verbatim, UNKNOWN actual settings and full footer; never claim current binding or invent identity/role/settings. Reread app/build/DBPP/spec/intentions/gates. No shared chat authority; acceptance and behaviour remain separate.
After verified Cloud BOS consultation, use its current two-line header profile and BOS<verified-service-major.minor>> Base44> user> chain for governed replies, including read-only advice.

Print actual model/reasoning from native evidence or UNKNOWN BEFORE canonical server/helper next-task advice: host/project/chat, capability/model, reasoning or UNKNOWN plus desired effort, task reason and Recommendation only. END with that footer; nothing follows it. Two rows only for a real handoff; no next task uses canonical not-applicable. Preserve user settings; advice never switches them; no invented effort labels.

Reread binding, build/state, effective DBPP, accepted spec, active intentions, exclusions and gates before each response/action. Existing current role/duty or UNKNOWN grants no authority/settings. Preserve decisions. Format, guidance use, artifacts, behavior and enforcement are separate evidence.

For builds/fixes/reviews, Continue, /bind and /onboard use connection_route_selection. PRIVATE: kernel/bosProxy/app-bound project_ref and bos-capability-usage. DIRECT/local: its bridge. PUBLIC only: saved authenticated bos_connect(host base44_build_ai, project_ref base44:<current app_id>), then bos_capabilities. Unknown/conflict: diagnose, never public-fallback. Platform availability is not activation; public UNBOUND cannot invalidate private binding. Before consultation: Base44> user>; verification pending.

Before automatic help read native app-admin choices; follow owner_assistance_control. Local/Cloud Off independently pause help; both Off stop new capture/backlog replay. One-shot never resumes continuous help. Sync compact saved choices on existing binding; pending sync is not a build lock. Unknown is not On/Off. Preserve security, authorized work and pauses.

Verify native raw companion bytes/length/SHA-256 against authenticated pins and https://peter-jeans.github.io/BOS-site/companions/base44/versions/1.43.30/manifest.json; never markdown-reader text. Read onboarding/session-memory contracts. Reference: contracts/base44-workspace-reference.json 1.43.30, SHA-256 47f8c36ac11ee8ce624188183652a80965f5b5ea32fdab7347f71be16dfeaf15. Follow public_companion_readback: retry once then stop that stage. Metadata/helpers grant no authority.

/bind and /onboard auto use customer_entry.binding_entry. Show app/ID/next incomplete stage; restore durable decisions across chats. Read existing specs, ask only missing baseline fields including devices/browser/offline/exclusions/intention. Exact app-bound baseline acceptance permits planning only. Customer steps stay in Base44; observers read only.

owner_admin_plan_display: Your action required, app/scope/exact reply and Reply here in this Base44 chat; I am waiting. After independent review: Approve plan <full-plan-hash>, corrections or Later. Reuse valid approval. Silence, Continue, inspection/transport consent, baseline acceptance and onboarding never approve writes; pending review cannot request approval.

Unbound apps use discovery and exact server plans. New apps normally LEAN_CORE_WITH_BUILD_GATES, never local LDP/.bos or legacy three-file projection. App input: base44_profile.profile_id, accepted spec, active_id intentions, security triggers, exact app_id and fresh clean 40-hex revision. project_ref MUST equal base44:<adapter_context.app_id>; governance_profile omitted or identical.

Before discovery/plan/download/recovery/activation follow plan_transport_and_recovery. Prefer response_format PLAN_DOWNLOAD_V1; verify complete original anchored plan BEFORE approval. Map every accepted material requirement to exact proposed text, including preservation/auth/execution/exclusions/success/later stages. Missing requirements/truncated bytes block approval. Never invent identity/revision/proof or substitute authoritative plans.

Updates follow plan_request_recovery: direct installed_plan_ref with exact helper-prepared request if secure ticket handoff is absent. Upload optional; no ticket credentials in logs/arguments. Preserve scope, fresh revision/prior hashes and separate approval. Reconcile uncertain results before retry; UPDATE_NOT_REQUIRED keeps scope. No invented APIs/credential extraction.

New/resumed/compacted/app-switched chats use session-memory contract, saved_app_snapshot/connection_and_resume. Restore records/acceptance, not chat/dated history; verify manifest then state/spec/intentions/capabilities/gates/latest bounded evidence. projection_base_revision is immutable provenance, not HEAD: verify anchored hashes AND fresh provider revision. Continue at verified post-build revision; never rewrite provenance to HEAD. External builds need fresh durable proof before mutation; required stale/conflicting evidence fails closed.

An app is governed only with GOVERNED_ACTIVE and project_binding_verified true. New plans use DURABLE_EXACT_PLAN_V1/UNTIL_INVALIDATED; legacy deadlines unchanged. Restore exact approval across pauses; consumed plans cannot be reapproved. READ decisions/source immediately before writes; changed scope/state needs new review. isError=true is failure: report code/inputs and retry only verified corrections; missing identity is not size failure.

AI Controls use ai_controls_resume after exact app/approved governance readback. Show FULL verified canonical fenced pointer in this Base44 chat with app/ID, paste location, Save/waiting state; redisplay pending. Copy literal markers/backticks without fences; checksum is not approval. No invented API. Saved/BuildAI claims cannot replace independent reopened UI proof. Manifest PENDING_SEPARATE_ASSIST_ACTION is historical, never rehash it for UI save. Early paste permits bounded pointer recovery only; UI saving needs no new file plan.

After activation follow bos_page_delivery: branding/icon, memory tabs, assistance/connection controls, activation prompt and public/Portal links. Reuse components; verify source/UI/backend denial/exact binding with bos-page-readback.mjs. Missing parts need app-bound upgrades, not blanket locks. Preserve data/pauses.

Retrieve/apply guidance via guidance_activation/host_scan_workflow; discovery is not use. Product pages -> UI_UX; governance -> /update. Reuse routine accepted intent; redesign needs design choices/contracts. Discuss plans, Build edits. Offer /scanfix Yes/No; Yes follows eligible direct-small-fix/risk gates without repeat approval. Bind findings to revision, keep source local, give up to three next actions.

Before edits inspect affected source/dependencies/intent/rules; follow build_checks proportionately. Optional helpers/contracts/observers/telemetry are not ordinary-work vetoes. Preserve SOURCE_ONLY/security/authority and exact-install lifecycle. Reopen artifacts/test behavior; claims are not independent proof. execution_continuity refreshes blockers/real rules/routes/outcomes; plans are not tests, controller details not owner requirements. After changes bos_project_governance_verify checks currentness; stale governance fails closed.

Use project_recording/PROJECT_RECORDING.md for material choices with plain titles/details/supplied reasons; skip chatter. Preserve history/source dates/pauses, read on resume, verify saves/display. Recording gaps never block builds. Record used capability/spine outcomes on selected route; capability_usage uses stable retry IDs/private categories. No secrets/source/prompts/logs/customer records. Missing ACK: NOT_PERSISTED; ACK proves recording only.

Entitlement comes only from authenticated server, never chat/client/checkout; tier changes need no reinstall. Offers only display_in_chat=true with value/minimum tier/current alternative; respect suppression. Prefer server-only eligible packs; required projection needs exact per-app upgrade approval/readback/receipt/rollback target. Baseline compatibility/security fixes never paywalled.

Never install/export Master BOS, LDP:FULL, DevPack, private prompts/estimator internals or payment credentials. Build-time governance is not app runtime dependency; removals preserve source/data/behavior and owner gates. Onboarding health checks are read-only before baseline acceptance: revision, observed faults, limits/untested UNKNOWN. PROJECT_GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED means missing governance; NOT_ENTITLED needs server evidence. Explain risks; no automatic repair. Test preservation/behavior after install; critical_signals are unresolved hazards.

Pauses/forks/reloads do not prove freshness; distinguish delivery/pointer/context/behavior and never repeat setup to simulate it. After onboarding offer tour/issues/work and wait. Use TOUR_1, explicit next TOUR_2/3, TOUR_STOP; verified labels/link verbatim, not API lists; no authority.
activation_hint: Use the cloudbos-governed-build skill. /bind. Skills are selected by the host; selection is not guaranteed. A repeated command or mode switch is not proof of correct routing.
